title: Custom Soccer Ball Goal Net Comforter Set, Machine Washabl - Design 13
description:
At Jeminise, we're thrilled to present this vibrant comforter set, specially designed for young soccer enthusiasts! Inspire dreams of the field with this cozy bedding, perfect for boys who look up to their favorite soccer stars and fuel their excitement for the game.

Key Features

  • Soccer Enthusiasm: Features a dynamic soccer theme, ideal for inspiring young fans and decorating a boys' room.
  • Available Sizes: Offered in US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), and US King (104" x 88") to fit various bed sizes.
  • Easy to Use Bedding: Designed with a hidden zipper and a smooth metal pull for effortless duvet insertion and removal.
  • Superior Manufacturing Process: Utilizes environmental protection techniques to ensure dye retention and prevent fading, with smooth, fine, and compact stitching for lasting enjoyment.
  • Included Components: This set includes one duvet cover.
  • Machine Washable: Simple care instructions: wash separately in cold water and air dry without heat for best results.
  • Material Details: Crafted from durable polycotton fabric.
